status: linkage_audit_only: conservative accident-to-road linkage audit and candidate segment inventories; no training, labels, zero-filled panels, probabilities, thresholds or risk colours
registered_by: task 014 (2026-11-11), before any spatial model, count target or resolution choice was evaluated

inputs.pin_policy: every input is read offline and hash-verified before any analysis. A null sha256 is a fail-closed placeholder: the notebook refuses to run until the accepted file hash is pinned here (shasum -a 256 <file>). Derived file hashes must equal BOTH this config and the accepted road manifest.

snapshot.rule: 'rc31' + first 8 hex of the accepted road cache_manifest_sha256; segment IDs are valid only within this pinned snapshot, never across historical road versions

envelope_note: fixed predeclared geometry-collection envelope (must equal the road manifest preregistration). NOT an SPU-Khao Yai route and not all six candidate provinces; inside-envelope is a scope filter, never road validation

crs.event_datum_assumption: event LATITUDE/LONGITUDE assumed WGS84 (EPSG:4326) without verification; no positional-accuracy or point-in-province claim is made

doh_highway.agency_exact: กรมทางหลวง
doh_highway.rule: NFKC + strip; must match ^[0-9]{1,4}$ (ASCII digits only), then zfill(4); anything else is route_nonstandard

drr_rural.agency_exact: กรมทางหลวงชนบท
drr_rural.rule: NFKC, remove all whitespace, collapse repeated dots, strip leading/trailing dots; standard = exactly two Thai consonants + '.' + exactly four ASCII digits (e.g. นบ.3021), leading zeros and prefix kept verbatim. Codes 'ส.' + digits are special_unverified; anything else nonstandard. No padding, no inserted dot, no alias

exat_expressway.agency_exact: การทางพิเศษแห่งประเทศไทย
exat_expressway.rule: no verified crosswalk between accident route codes (e.g. E007S013|I) and geometry routes (RAE, FES, ...): every EXAT event is identity_unresolved; exact name equalities are listed as unadopted proposals only

alias_map_note: empty by default. An entry would be {source_id: {raw_normalized_code: {target: geometry_code, evidence: citation}}}; entries without evidence are refused. None is verified.

matching.note: preregistered before any model score exists; never tuned. Eligibility = same agency source AND verified normalized route identity AND projected distance <= tolerance. Ambiguity uses every same-identity candidate within best+margin (also beyond the tolerance), so matched sets are monotone in the tolerance

segmentation.endpoint_convention: segments run along the digitised direction of each clipped piece; interval [start, end) is half-open except the last segment of a piece, which is closed [start, piece_end]; a point exactly at a boundary belongs to the downstream segment
segmentation.short_final_rule: the last segment of a piece keeps the remainder length (never merged, never padded) and is flagged short_final when shorter than the target

panel_estimate.week_rule: W-MON weekly periods overlapping the split date range

km_diagnostic.note: raw KM is diagnostic only (units unverified); it is never a match criterion
